mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that may have additive CNS depressant effects and theoretical risk of serotonergic potentiation with venlafaxine, though systemic absorption of ophthalmic brimonidine is minimal.
action: Monitor for increased sedation, dizziness, or blood pressure changes; ophthalmic brimonidine at standard doses poses minimal risk but counsel patient on signs of excessive CNS depression.
